A wide range of Modules and Tools Covered Overview of the Cloud and AWS Cloud Computing – Computing in the cloud means providing hosted services over the internet. Infrastructure as a service (IaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), and software as a service (SaaS) are the three main types of cloud computing that offer these features (SaaS). Cloud Computing Infrastructure – The hardware and software that make cloud computing possible are called “cloud computing infrastructure.” It has storage, networking, computing power, and a way for users to access their virtualized resources. Cloud Service And Deployment Models – The cloud service models tell you how much control you have over your resources and how much control your cloud service providers have over them. The way resources are given out in the cloud is shown by cloud deployment models. Identity And Access Management Techniques (IAM) – With the help of IAM, you can control which employees and which responsibilities inside your company have access to which resources. Employing an identity management and access solution eliminates the need for a human administrator to log into every employee app. Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) – Elastic Compute Cloud is what EC2 is short for. The AWS cloud platform has an on-demand computing service called EC2. It includes all the services a computer can give you and the freedom of a virtual environment under the computing category. It also lets the user set up their instances according to their needs. S3 – Amazon’s Simple Storage Solution (Amazon S3) is a market-leading object storage service thanks to its unparalleled speed, safety, and scalability. Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) allows users to store data and access it from anywhere in the world at any time. AWS Databases RDS and Dynamodb – RDS lets you set up, run, and scale relational (SQL) databases on AWS. There are different types of instances you can use. AWS DynamoDB is a serverless solution that automatically adjusts the size of tables based on their capacity.
